bus_routes: Situated roughly 310 km east of Hyderabad, translating to a standard 6 to 7-hour road journey depending on city exit traffic layers.
TGRTC and APSRTC operate bus services from Mahatma Gandhi Bus Station (MGBS), Hyderabad
Supplemental departures are handled through the Jubilee Bus Station (JBS) in Secunderabad for northern suburban commuters.
Frequent district-link shuttle networks run directly from Khammam Bus Station, located approximately 120 km away.
Direct inter-state highway bus connections route consistently from the Pandit Nehru Bus Station (PNBS) in Vijayawada, sitting 180 km away.

railway.station: Bhadrachalam Road Station (located at Kothagudem - BDCR)

railway_stations.station: Bhadrachalam Road Station (located at Kothagudem - BDCR)
railway_stations.details: Nearest railway station. Regular buses connect Kothagudem railway station to Bhadrachalam every 15 minutes.

parking_and_transit.parking_areas: Dedicated parking spaces are maintained by the temple administration near the temple entrance and town bus stand.
parking_and_transit.local_shuttles: Shared and private auto-rickshaws connect the bus stand and local choultries directly to the temple gates.
